About Me

Fair, Accurate & Insightful Analysis

I'm Bolu Ola, a data analyst and business analyst with a passion for turning complex datasets into clear, actionable intelligence. I bring both technical rigour and storytelling ability to every project.

My work spans retail, finance, trade, and public sector data — always with a focus on data integrity, meaningful visualisation, and real business impact.

Nigeria Foreign Trade in Goods Statistics 2023

Comprehensive analysis of Nigeria's N71.88 trillion total trade — a 37.23% year-on-year increase. Covers exports (N35.96bn), imports (N35.92bn), top trading partners across Asia, Europe & America, and breakdowns by commodity category including crude oil (80.64% of exports), manufactured goods, agriculture, and transport mode.

Data source: Nigeria Bureau of Statistics

View full project →
Power BI

Import Trading Partners — Nigeria 2023

Breakdown of Nigeria's N36bn imports by continent and category. Asia led at N19bn (53.1%), followed by Europe at N12bn. Manufactured goods dominated at N18bn (52.89%).

View dashboard →
Power BI

Export Trading Partners — Nigeria 2023

Analysis of Nigeria's N36bn exports by continent and commodity. Europe received 45.41%, crude oil made up 80.64% of total exports at N29bn. Top partners: Netherlands, Vietnam, India.

View dashboard →
Power BI

Transport Media & Port Operations 2023

Deep-dive into Nigeria's trade transport modes. Maritime dominated with N36bn in exports. Apapa Port handled N34.53bn in exports and N23bn in imports — the country's busiest port by far.
